results.name: The narration transcript is byte-for-byte identical to the guidance message returned by the shared guidance endpoint
The narration response reports the same real sourceContext as the guidance response (single source of truth)
A mentor with a configured voice honestly reports unavailable (provider_not_configured), never fabricated audio
A mentor with no configured voice honestly reports unavailable (no_voice_configured)
Every narration response includes a real request ID
A client-supplied "text" field is silently ignored — narration always uses the server-computed guidance message
A narration request with no mentorId is rejected
Saved preferences persist and are read back exactly (refresh persistence, same cookie identity)
A second independent fetch under the same identity returns identical preferences (same-account second device)
A separate guest's narration request succeeds independently of guest 1's state
One guest's narration/preference activity never leaks into or overwrites a different guest's preferences
